response.text: Your continued pressure and threats make it very clear to us that you want to get paid and close this deal. The amount of money you are asking is nowhere near a realistic price to pay for the data you have shown us. We have said this time and time again. Your new threat to notify the media and your continued efforts to threaten our business, our leadership and our customers will not change our valuation of the data and will not influence our position. We have clearly demonstrated the price range we are able to work within. Stop playing your games, wasting our time and let’s close this business deal. give us a price within range of our offer and our leadership team will discuss making a deal.
